facts.statement: The genus Heliadornis was described by Olson in 1985.
Heliadornis lived during the Miocene epoch.
Heliadornis was native to temperate climates.
Two species of Heliadornis have been recognized.
Remains of Heliadornis ashbyi have been found in Maryland, United States, and Antwerp province, Belgium.
facts.quote: Heliadornis ashbyi is known from remains in Maryland in the United States and Antwerp province in Belgium

facts.statement: Fossils of Heliadornis ashbyi from Belgium were found on the Brussels–Antwerp motorway between Berchem and Wilrijk.
facts.quote: The latter were from the Brussels–Antwerp motorway between Berchem and Wilrijk

facts.statement: The species Heliadornis paratethydicus was described from Upper Miocene strata in Vösendorf, Austria.
facts.quote: A second species, Heliadornis paratethydicus has been described from Upper Miocene strata in Vösendorf, Austria

facts.statement: Heliadornis belongs to the family Phaethontidae.
Heliadornis lived between 15.98 and 11.63 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Langhian to Serravallian (15.98 to 11.63 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Heliadornis is a genus of prehistoric seabirds related to modern tropicbirds.
rejected.quote: Heliadornis is a genus of prehistoric seabirds related to modern tropicbirds
